title: Keeping Time vs. Understanding Time: Neither Alone Explains Temporal Reasoning in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.29507v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Temporal reasoning is widely assumed to decompose into two modes: temporal arithmetic (date and time calculations), and temporal semantics (understanding temporal and causal relations). This dichotomy shapes how benchmarks are designed, how models are trained, and how progress is measured, yet its empirical validity has never been directly tested. We provide two lines of evidence that challenge it. First, we test whether tasks labelled as arithmetic or semantic by the benchmarks support transferable gains within their purported mode. Finetuning on these subsets yields predominantly dataset-specific gains ($+6.8$ to $+23.1$ percentage points), while transfer to a different dataset in the same mode ranges from $-3.2$ to $+1.1$ percentage points. translated_title: 计时与理解时间：二者皆无法单独解释大语言模型的时间推理能力
translated_abstract: 人们普遍假设时间推理可以分解为两种模式：时间算术（日期与时间的计算）和时间语义（理解时间与因果关系）。这种二分法塑造了基准测试的设计方式、模型的训练方式以及进展的衡量标准，然而其经验有效性从未被直接检验过。我们提供了两条挑战这一假设的证据。首先，我们检验被基准标注为算术或语义的任务是否能在其所属模式内带来可迁移的收益。在这些子集上进行微调主要产生数据集特定的收益（+6.8 至 +23.1 个百分点），而迁移到同一模式下的不同数据集时收益仅为 -3.2 至 +1.1 个百分点。在迁移分析涉及的两个基准测试家族中，这一模式几乎无法证明存在连贯且可迁移的时间能力。其次，使用基于认知需求的模型评估方法……
tldr: 该论文通过微调迁移实验和基于认知需求的评估，挑战了将时间推理划分为“时间算术”与“时间语义”的主流二分法，证明二者都不能单独解释大语言模型的时间推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper challenges the prevailing dichotomy between temporal arithmetic and temporal semantics in LLM temporal reasoning, demonstrating through finetuning transfer experiments and cognitive-demand-based evaluation that neither mode alone explains temporal reasoning ability.
